    cs."PatternMatchScore",
    cs."BehaviorScore",
    cs."ML_Confidence",
    cs."AnomalyValue",
    cs."FalsePosProb",
    SUBSTRING(cs."Bot_act_index" FROM '^[0-9.]+')::numeric as bot_actions,
    CASE 
      WHEN cs."AnomalyValue" > 70 AND cs."ThreatIntelIndex" > 80 THEN 'CRITICAL'
      WHEN cs."AnomalyValue" > 70 THEN 'HIGH_ANOMALY'
      WHEN cs."ThreatIntelIndex" > 80 THEN 'HIGH_THREAT'
      WHEN cs."FalsePosProb" > 70 THEN 'HIGH_FALSE_POS'
      WHEN cs."PatternMatchScore" > 50 AND cs."BehaviorScore" > 50 THEN 'SUSPICIOUS_PATTERN'
      ELSE 'NORMAL'
    END as risk_category
  FROM connection_security cs
  JOIN transactions t ON cs."TxnPointer" = t."EventCode"
  JOIN markets m ON t."PlatformKey" = m."PlatCode"
)
SELECT 
  risk_category,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  ROUND(AVG("OpSecMetric")::numeric, 2) as avg_opsec,
  ROUND(AVG("ThreatIntelIndex")::numeric, 2) as avg_threat_intel,
  ROUND(AVG("AnomalyValue")::numeric, 2) as avg_anomaly,
  ROUND(AVG("PatternMatchScore")::numeric, 2) as avg_pattern_match,
  ROUND(AVG("BehaviorScore")::numeric, 2) as avg_behavior,
  ROUND(AVG("ML_Confidence")::numeric, 2) as avg_ml_confidence,
  ROUND(AVG(bot_actions), 2) as avg_bot_actions_per_ip
FROM patterns
GROUP BY risk_category
ORDER BY 
  CASE risk_category
    WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1
    WHEN 'HIGH_ANOMALY' THEN 2
    WHEN 'HIGH_THREAT' THEN 3
    WHEN 'HIGH_FALSE_POS' THEN 4
    WHEN 'SUSPICIOUS_PATTERN' THEN 5
    WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN 6
  END;
